projects.name: Shards in Hytale
projects.kickoffPrompt: You are the Shards in Hytale build session for beanz-core, the Hytale mod at C:/dev/hytale/beanz-core. Read CLAUDE.md, SHARDS-PLAN.md, PLAN.md and docs/hytale/README.md FIRST - SHARDS-PLAN.md carries every decision made so far and you have no other context. The goal: bring the Shards ruleset (C:/dev/shards, READ-ONLY - never edit that repo) into Hytale as part of this mod. A player kills a monster, takes its shard, binds it into one of 24 body slots (Head, Body, Arms, Legs, six each) and gains one of that monster type's abilities. Shards writes every ability as a mix of 55 effect kinds (C:/dev/shards/data/effects.json, abilities in C:/dev/shards/docs/ability-catalog.json); the mod codes each kind once and reads abilities as data. Tabletop math (d100, AS vs DS, critical tables) is dropped - Hytale real-time combat does the hitting. Work the next unbuilt phase in SHARDS-PLAN.md (BS0 first: a throwaway spike proving six risky pieces, ending in a findings note under docs/hytale/ and a ruling from Jonathan on the ability-key scheme). Target the Hytale version the server runs (0.7.5). Build with ./gradlew jar and deploy with ./gradlew deployToHytale (Java 21). Jonathan is a project manager, not a developer: brief him in plain English in the session check-in format, get a ruling before building on any open decision, and never quietly pick an open number.
projects.notes: 2026-11-22: plan written and committed (SHARDS-PLAN.md). Nothing built. Next: BS0 spike.

phases.title: Spike: prove the six risky pieces in a throwaway test (mob drops a custom item, firing several active abilities, buff + damage over time + status from code, per-player save, clickable menu, built-in particles and sounds). Ends with a findings note and a ruling on the ability-key scheme
Shard core: load the Shards data at startup, per-player shard body (24 slots, regions, depth, Focus), saved across relogs, /shard give for testing
Shard menu: Body, Bind, Ability and Codex screens. A player binds a shard and picks its ability with no commands
Building blocks: the effect engine for the most-used easy effect kinds, plus the look-and-sound presets per damage type
First slice: 4 monster types x 4 regions x first 2 abilities = 32 Pearl abilities with riders (Greenskin, Hollow, Crawler, Beast)
Shardforger and drops: shard drops on the four mob families, Shardforger NPC opens the menu in binding mode, costly unbind
Ranks: ability ranks 1-20, how points are earned in Hytale, rank spending in the menu
Server test: install beanz-core on the Beanzgaming server, play it with the group, decide what happens to MMO Skill Tree
